correctness.rationale: The Debarre--Manivel coefficient formula specializes to the stated bivariate product. Reducing its factors modulo three gives a zero factor for n divisible by three and, in the other two residue classes, exactly the monomial times (x+y)^{2m} shown in the proof. The target coefficient is the Catalan difference. Deutsch--Sagan supplies the independent ternary residue theorem for Catalan numbers. The density count follows by an exact digit count.

value.rationale: The claim completes the modulus-three row that a dedicated prior congruence paper left implicit, replacing a numerical pattern by a closed Catalan law. It yields an exact ternary automaton for every residue and the structural consequence that three divides the canonical complex line count in a density-one set of dimensions. This is an infinite classification of a natural enumerative invariant, not a finite table recomputation.
